mintAuthority.summary: Movement USDCx is an inherited Circle USDC representation, not an independently canonical Movement-native issuance deployment. The Movement token object requires xReserve-signed messages and exposes no permissionless local free-mint path. Its xReserve attester, Movement attester, admin, pause, route-policy, and compatible package-upgrade powers are bridge capabilities preserved in structured Bridge Risk controls.

review.evidence: At Movement ledger version 195984896 and block height 85264354, the authored USDCx deployment is a bridge representation: its mint entry requires an xReserve message and signature, while current get_attesters() returns two keys and the token object exposes no independent permissionless native issuance path. The Movement 4-of-6 admin/package owner can change attesters, pause state, route policy, and compatible function bodies without an observed delay, but those controls govern the bridge representation and are preserved under Bridge Risk. Circle xReserve locks Ethereum USDC and gates remote mint/burn through attestations, so reconciliation remains continuous; no supervisory regime was established for the Movement deployment. The current module response exposes bytecode and ABI but source_digest is null, so no stronger source-level upgrade claim is made.
